positive.name: the documented statusline payload (code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline.md, read 2026-09-17, trimmed to the keys this script reads plus their neighbours; values are the docs' own: Opus, ctx 8%, 5h 23.5%, 7d 41.2%, spend 62.8%) -- writes ~/.claude/usage-windows.json and prints the one-line status. touches snapshots and restores the live file byte-for-byte.

negative.name: the same documented payload before the session's first API response: rate_limits absent (the docs state the field appears only after the first response) and context_window percentages null (may be null early in the session). Must print only the model name, never a placeholder, and must leave ~/.claude/usage-windows.json alone -- a windowless refresh from one session must not blank another session's good reading.
